prompt: How long does a free Postgres database last on Render?

result.text:
On Render, a free PostgreSQL database lasts for 30 days from the date of creation.

Key Timeline & Details

Expiration (Day 30): Once the 30 days are up, the free database becomes inaccessible.

Grace Period (14 days): After expiration, you have a 14-day window to upgrade the database to a paid compute plan to keep your data.

Permanent Deletion: If you do not upgrade within the 14-day grace period, Render permanently deletes the database and all of its data.

Notifications: Render sends automated email warnings as you approach the 30-day expiration mark and again near the end of the grace period.

Other Free Postgres Limits

Storage: Capped at 1 GB of data.

Instances: Limited to 1 active free instance per workspace.

Backups & Pooling: Free databases do not support backups or managed connection pooling.

Maintenance & Restarts: Render can restart or perform maintenance on free databases at any time, causing temporary unavailability.

Review full details directly on the Render Free Tier Documentation.
